message:
Let me try to understand the vulnerability by looking at the actual code flow. The key is that `xmlXPathGetElementsByIds` calls `xmlGetID` which returns an attribute pointer. Then it accesses `attr->parent`. The use-after-free happens when the attribute has been freed.

Let me look at how XInclude can free nodes. Let me check the xinclude.c code:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'grep -n "xmlFree\|xmlFreeNode\|xmlFreeProp\|xmlFreeDoc" /gt/_work/src/xinclude.c | head -40'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
